text:
marta-security: FYI alert from provisioner: several tenants had roles wiped after the RBAC rollout. SCIM shows groups replaced with [] and service logs show `kms: decrypt failed: envelope context mismatch`.

raj-sre: Can you paste the SCIM snippet and the exact KMS error?

marta-security: snippet: {event: scim:update, user: U-XXXX, ops: [{replace groups []}]} followed by `kms: decrypt failed: envelope context mismatch` then `apply-provisioning: applied role delta: []`.

alice-iam: That error means unwrap used wrong context/alias. If decrypt fails we should abort. New RBAC path has a fallback that treats errors as empty roles.

tim-identity: Confirmed: feature-flag `rbac_v2.safe_apply_on_kms_error` was ramped this morning. Alias rotation happened in EU earlier. Overlap likely.

marta-security: Immediate actions: 1) flip flag off 2) stop auto-backfills 3) identify affected tenants and rewrap role blobs then replay role sets.

tim-identity: Flipping flag now.

deploy-bot: feature-flag-svc: toggled `rbac_v2.safe_apply_on_kms_error` -> OFF by tim-identity at 2026-03-23T16:01:30Z :white_check_mark:

raj-sre: I ran an audit query: ~28 tenants show role.remove events since the rollout, mostly EU.

tim-identity: I'll run a rewrap job: try decrypt with old material (we keep rekey bucket), then encrypt with current alias + tenant context. Prioritizing 3 tenants that lost admin/service-account roles.

alice-iam: Also enrich audit entries with `error_hint: kms_envelope_context_mismatch` so CS/support can triage. Tag replayed events as `replayed_kms_fix`.

marta-security: Opening INC-2026-00378 for tracking and customer comms.

raj-sre: Note to billing/infra teams: role removals may have triggered rate-limit and quota issues for some apps; follow-ups needed.

marta-security: Quick mitigation complete: flag off. Rewrap+replay in progress; priority tenants done. Postmortem scheduled. CI change proposal: require explicit opt-in and tests for any feature that swallows crypto errors.

tim-identity: Adding CI lint and rollout checklist item. Will post progress updates here.

marta-security: Thanks all, closing triage unless verification finds further anomalies. :thumbsup:
